basis: S12a (2026-10-26.2 after review R1-R4 on PR #361): user rulings 2026-10-26 after the S12 error analysis found about 28% of segment errors were Golden or scoring artifacts. (1) Near-identical passages across documents credit each other once 本合同/本条款/本附加合同 and footnote marks are folded, still by exact containment of at least copy_min_chars; a footnote mark is a 1-2 digit number right after a Han character and right before a connective (的后或及和与并等之者), so measured numbers (15日, 24小时, 24分钟) and 第N never fold. (2) Headings and reader-guide lines of terms and brochures are neutral; rate-table cells are not headings. (3) Brochure restatements are neutral for a field whose Golden cites the terms; footnote blocks and the definitions section are neutral unless the field's card asks for definitions or footnotes.
clause_number_pattern: ^\s*(?:第[一二三四五六七八九十百零\d]+[条章节]|\d+(?:\.\d+)+|\d+[、.．]|[（(][一二三四五六七八九十\d]+[）)])
chapter_heading_pattern: ^(?:第[一二三四五六七八九十百零\d]+章|\d+[.．、](?!\d))
